en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large monumental building with a tall clock tower and statue on top, seen from a cobbled square or street. The façade features arcades on the ground level and rows of windows above. Trees and ornate street lamps stand in the foreground, and another richly decorated building borders the right edge. Printed captions at the top read "Dresden." on the left and "Neues Rathaus." on the right.
